description: Dry run of the listing automation on a one-item-per-listing marketplace (Vinted), from the CRM's own data — nothing is sent to the marketplace. Counts live listings whose product has another unit (they would be listed again after a sale), listings of the last unit (they would wait for stock), listings of products whose stock the CRM does not count (never listed again), and sold or removed products still in stock (list them yourself), with sample names. Running it records that a dry run was done, which update_listing_automation needs before it may turn a behaviour on; show the person these numbers first. The result echoes the workspace.

platform.description: The marketplace whose listing automation this is. Only vinted has one today.
